title: Branding Manager
description:
With **31\+ years of trust and industry expertise**, **Ashika Group** is one of India’s leading diversified financial\-services organizations, offering solutions across stock broking, wealth management, investment banking, NBFC, mutual funds, insurance, portfolio management and fintech.

We are looking for an experienced **Brand \& Marketing leader** to take ownership of how Ashika Group is perceived across India — from young, first\-time investors and millennials to affluent families, HNIs and corporate/institutional clients.

The role will also play a key part in building **Dhanush** as a next\-generation consumer investing and trading brand.

What will you do?

You will lead the overall **brand strategy, positioning and marketing roadmap** for Ashika Group and its businesses, translating business objectives into impactful brand and marketing initiatives.

Your responsibilities will include:

* Developing Ashika Group’s long\-term **brand strategy, positioning and brand architecture**
* Building audience\-specific messaging for **Gen Z, millennials, families, HNIs and institutional audiences**
* Leading **360° integrated campaigns** across digital, social media, influencers, print, outdoor, events and branches
* Driving **brand and product marketing for Dhanush**, including GTM strategy, positioning and launch campaigns
* Simplifying complex financial and investment products into engaging, easy\-to\-understand communication
* Building a consistent brand voice across content, social, digital and offline channels
* Identifying opportunities around **creators, partnerships, sponsorships, campuses, events and thought leadership**
* Managing creative, media, PR and branding agencies
* Working closely with leadership, product, sales, digital and business teams
* Using consumer insights, data and campaign performance to continuously improve marketing effectiveness

Who are we looking for?

* **7–15 years** of experience in Brand Marketing, Consumer Marketing, Integrated Marketing or Brand Strategy
* Proven experience in **building, scaling or repositioning consumer brands**
* Strong experience across **digital \+ ATL \+ BTL \+ social media**
* Hands\-on experience in **product marketing and GTM**
* Strong understanding of storytelling, content, social media and consumer engagement
* Comfortable with **Gen Z, creator economy, short\-form content and digital\-first marketing**
* Equally capable of building **trust\-led communication for mature investors, HNIs and corporate audiences**
* Strong agency, stakeholder and project management skills
* Strategic thinker with a **high bias for action and execution**

Preferred Background

Candidates from **BFSI, fintech, stock broking, wealth management, banking, NBFC, insurance or asset management** will be preferred.

Pay: ₹40,000\.00 \- ₹80,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person
